title: AttnSR: Attention Step Reward for Long-Horizon Agentic RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.07932v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents make multi-step decisions, yet outcome-reward-only reinforcement learning provides little direct supervision for individual steps. We introduce AttnSR, a step-level reward augmentation method that derives reward allocations from policy attention extracted during training replay, without a separately trained reward model or additional rollouts. AttnSR traces backward through the policy model attention graph to estimate the relevance of earlier steps to the final response. The terminal step, measured relative to a running baseline, determines whether these rewards reinforce or penalize the selected steps. In a controlled Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct study, AttnSR consistently outperforms the PPO baseline across all evaluated checkpoints on ALFWorld, raising final held-out success from 91.2% to 97.1%. translated_title: AttnSR：面向长程智能体强化学习的注意力步级奖励
translated_abstract: 长程LLM智能体需要进行多步决策，然而仅使用结果奖励的强化学习难以对各个步骤提供直接的监督信号。我们提出了AttnSR，这是一种步级奖励增强方法，它从训练回放中提取的策略注意力推导奖励分配，无需单独训练的奖励模型，也无需额外的 rollout。AttnSR 通过在策略模型的注意力图中反向追踪，来估计先前步骤与最终响应的相关性。终端步骤相对于运行基线进行度量，其结果决定这些奖励是强化还是惩罚所选择的步骤。在受控的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 实验中，AttnSR 在 ALFWorld 上所有评估检查点均持续优于 PPO 基线，将最终留出集成功率从 91.2% 提升至 97.1%。消融实验表明，其收益取决于中间奖励的分配方式，而非简单的累加。
tldr: 提出 AttnSR 步级奖励增强方法，利用训练回放中的策略注意力反向追踪为各步骤分配奖励，无需额外奖励模型，即在 ALFWorld 上将 Qwen2.5-7B 的成功率从 91.2% 提升至 97.1%。
en_tdlr: AttnSR augments outcome-based RL with step-level rewards derived by backward-tracing policy attention from training replay—requiring no separate reward model—raising ALFWorld success from 91.2% to 97.1% over PPO.
